Pipelining doesn’t help latency of single instruction
it helps throughput of entire workload

supporting_quotes.exact:
Structural Hazards: An instruction in the pipeline needs a resource
being used by another instruction in the pipeline

observations.subject: instruction in the pipeline
observations.object: a resource being used by another instruction in the pipeline

claims.rationale: 引文直接定义结构冒险为流水线中的一条指令需要另一条流水线指令正在使用的资源。该来源 provenance 为空，无法证明引文独立性。

supporting_quotes.exact:
RAW data hazards occur when one instruction depends on a data value
produced by a preceding instruction still in the pipeline.

observations.subject: RAW data hazards
observations.object: one instruction depends on a data value produced by a preceding instruction still in the pipeline

claims.rationale: 引文直接说明 RAW 数据冒险发生于一条指令依赖前序指令产生、且前序指令仍在流水线中的数据值。该来源 provenance 为空，无法证明引文独立性。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Control Hazards: Whether or not an instruction should be executed
depends on a control decision made by an earlier instruction

observations.subject: whether an instruction should be executed
observations.object: a control decision made by an earlier instruction

claims.rationale: 引文直接说明后续指令是否执行取决于前序指令作出的控制决策。该来源 provenance 为空，无法证明引文独立性。

supporting_quotes.exact:
WAW and WAR Name Hazards: An instruction in the pipeline is
writing a register that an earlier instruction in the pipeline is either
writing or reading

observations.subject: WAW and WAR
observations.object: an instruction writing a register that an earlier instruction is either writing or reading

claims.rationale: 引文直接将 WAW 和 WAR 标为名称冒险，并说明涉及对同一寄存器的写写或写读关系。该来源 provenance 为空，无法证明引文独立性。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Superscalar processors enable CPI < 1 (i.e., IPC > 1) by
executing multiple instructions in parallel

Can have both in-order and out-of-order superscalar processors,
but we will start by exploring in-order

observations.subject: superscalar processors
observations.object: CPI < 1 (IPC > 1) by executing multiple instructions in parallel

claims.rationale: 第一条引文支持超标量通过并行执行多条指令提高指令吞吐，第二条明确说明超标量既可以按序也可以乱序，因此超标量不等于乱序执行。两个引文来自同一 source，不能据此证明独立来源。

supporting_quotes.exact:
Hardware Scheduling: Hardware dynamically schedules
instructions to avoid RAW hazards, potentially allowing
instructions to execute out of order
commit stage waits for pending bit of head to be clear

observations.subject: hardware scheduling
observations.object: instructions to execute out of order

observations.subject: commit stage
observations.object: pending bit of head to be clear

claims.rationale: 第一条引文支持就绪指令可能乱序执行；第二条支持提交阶段等待队首状态清除，部分支持按程序顺序提交。但引文未明确提到 ROB，也未明确说明维持精确状态，因此整体只能部分支持。来源均未提供 provenance，独立性未知。
